body.name: Deterministic-prefix variance estimator
body.construction: At time \(n\), put \(k_n=\lfloor n/4\rfloor\) and, for each \(a\in\mathcal A\), \(\widehat v_{a,n}=\widehat v_a(k_n;O)\). Then put \(\widehat Q_{n,B}=n^{-1}\sum_{b=1}^Bm_b\{\widehat v_{1,n}/p_b+\widehat v_{0,n}/(1-p_b)\}\) and \(\widehat{\mathrm{se}}_{n,B}=(\widehat Q_{n,B}/n)^{1/2}\).
